text.War World:
How to Play ==
When you play War World you gain 3 Combat Power. If the ally ability is triggered Combat Power goes up to 7. War World is an Outpost with a defense of 4.
 Strategy ==
This Outpost breaths sheer Combat Power. An ally card boost its powers to a Combat Power of 7 making your attack beefy. Opponents make it their priority to take it out as quickly as possible, which is not that hard because this Outpost had only a defense of 4.
